thread:
maria_ops: Heads up — APAC vendor SunRail just alerted us: PO SR-8421 lead time slipped. Sea ETA moved from 2026-04-12 to 2026-05-05 due to a customs backlog at SG port.
liam_procure: How many GPUs affected?
maria_ops: 48 H100s total. Vendor says 12 can be air-expressed sooner but at a premium.
kevin_logistics: Can we get a consolidated AWB for the 12 so we stage quickly into the enclave?
liam_procure: What's the air premium? Need ballpark for approvals.
sara_finance: We need the delta per unit and a total impact. Air will push O&M if big.
maria_ops: Vendor quoted +$4,200/unit for air (D2D incl expedited brokerage). Sea remains at contract price.
nana_customs: The SG backlog is paperwork throughput. If we pre-clear and file a temporary import bond, we can save ~3 business days. Bonds need underwriter signoff.
kevin_logistics: For the 12 air units, request consolidated AWB + single invoice to simplify customs.
rma-bot: Note: prior consolidated AWB shipments reduced port hold times by ~28%.
liam_procure: Options: 1) Air 12 at premium to cover priority Dedicated pools. 2) Keep all 48 by sea and accept delay. 3) Hybrid: air 12 + expedite paperwork (bond) for the rest. Preference?
sara_finance: Hybrid looks best cost/latency wise but I can only approve up to $35k without escalation. Engineering risk needs >$100k to go higher.
maria_ops: Also RMA snag: vendor pre-check flagged 4 units DOA. Vendor offers replacements under RMA but replacements are slated on same delayed sea manifest unless separated.
kevin_logistics: Separating RMA replacements into an air leg is possible but expensive. Alternative: borrow 4 loaners from EU stash and do cross-region swap — adds transfer time and customs paperwork.
liam_procure: Are cross-region loaners OK for SLAs? Deployment leads said APAC Dedicated clusters can tolerate a 2-week shortfall if 12 units arrive early.
maria_ops: Deployment confirmed they can handle short-term with 36 units, but 4 DOAs block specific tenant rollouts.
nana_customs: For the 36 sea units I can push pre-clear if vendor provides serial manifest + HS codes within 24h. Can someone confirm we get manifest EOD?
liam_procure: I'll ask vendor for manifest and request consolidated AWB for the 12 air pieces. Maria, please ask vendor for separate commercial invoice for the air leg and a distinct RMA AWB for the 4 replacements.
sara_finance: If vendor insists on air for ALL 4 RMA replacements, push them to share at least 50% of the expedite cost — they caused the DOAs.
maria_ops: Vendor replied: "Can do air for the 12 at +$4.2k/unit. For RMA: we will air 2/4 replacements at no charge; remaining 2 will go on sea manifest. We can provide consolidated AWB & commercial invoices once you confirm."
kevin_logistics: That reduces our premium. Ana — any short-bond underwriter recs?
ana_customs: I'll ping Pacific Surety; they usually turn around in ~48h and can fast-track if we sign today.
liam_procure: Proposal: approve hybrid (air 12 + vendor covers 2 RMA air units), issue temporary import bond for sea leg, require manifest by EOD, finance approve up to $35k.
sara_finance: Approved up to $35k contingent on vendor covering the 2 RMA air units. If vendor reneges, escalate to Ops Lead.
maria_ops: Action items: liam to fetch manifest & invoices; kevin to prep AWB routing + inbound tag instructions; ana to contact bond underwriter; sara to lock approval.
liam_procure: Sent vendor email — requested manifest link and draft AWB.
rma-bot: RMA checklist reminder: include serials, failure codes, RMA authorization IDs, and photo evidence. Missing fields will delay processing.
maria_ops: Also creating inventory tag APAC-EXP-1742 for the 12 air units so on-receipt automation routes them into Dedicated pools.
kevin_logistics: I'll put the tag in the AWB instructions.
maria_ops: Vendor posted manifest: https://files.sunrail.com/manifests/SR-8421-1742.csv and AWB draft; origin NRT, final SIN-bonded.
kevin_logistics: AWB looks fine.
sara_finance: Keep me posted if vendor tries to back out of RMA cost share.
maria_ops: Hybrid approved. I'll push a short note to infra-all with expected delta and ETA.
kevin_logistics: If bond paperwork is rejected, fallback is air all RMA units — cost increases materially.
maria_ops: Understood. Monitoring the bond progress. Will update once manifest and broker confirm.
